paragraphs: Unless the context requires otherwise, the words "MannKind," "we," "Company," "us" and "our" refer to MannKind Corporation and its subsidiaries.

We are a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming chronic disease care through innovative, patient-centric solutions. Focused on cardiometabolic and orphan lung diseases, we develop and commercialize treatments that address serious unmet medical needs, including diabetes, pulmonary hypertension, and fluid overload in heart failure and chronic kidney disease. With deep expertise in drug-device combinations, we aim to deliver therapies designed to fit seamlessly into daily life.

Our cardiometabolic business is currently comprised of three commercial products: Afrezza (insulin human) Inhalation Powder; Furoscix (furosemide injection); and the V-Go wearable insulin delivery device:

• Afrezza is an ultra rapid-acting inhaled insulin indicated to improve glycemic control in adults with diabetes. Afrezza was developed by us and consists of a dry powder formulation of human insulin delivered from a small portable inhaler. Administered at the beginning of a meal, Afrezza dissolves rapidly upon inhalation to the lung and delivers insulin quickly to the bloodstream.

• Furoscix is a novel formulation of furosemide that delivers an 80 mg dose via an on-body infusor over a five-hour period. Furoscix is indicated for the treatment of edema in pediatric patients who weigh at least 43 kg and adult patients with chronic heart failure or chronic kidney disease. Furoscix is the first FDA-approved subcutaneous loop diuretic that delivers intravenous-equivalent diuresis at home as opposed to a hospital setting. Furoscix was developed by scPharmaceuticals Inc. ("scPharma"), which we acquired in October 2025. See Note 3 - Business Combinations in the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 – Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.

• V-Go is a mechanical basal-bolus insulin delivery system that is worn like a patch and can eliminate the need for taking multiple daily injections. V-Go administers a continuous preset basal rate of insulin over 24 hours and provides discreet on-demand bolus dosing at mealtimes. V-Go received 510(k) clearance by the FDA in 2010 and has been available commercially since 2012. In May 2022, we acquired V-Go from Zealand Pharma A/S and Zealand Pharma US, Inc. (together "Zealand").

We anticipate two potential milestones for our cardiometabolic business in 2026 based on regulatory submissions that we made in 2025. The FDA is currently reviewing a supplemental Biologics License Application ("sBLA") pursuant to which we are seeking approval for Afrezza in children and adolescents living with type 1 or type 2 diabetes. The sBLA has been assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act ("PDUFA") target action date of May 29, 2026. The FDA is also reviewing a supplemental New Drug Application ("sNDA") pursuant to which we are seeking approval for Furoscix ReadyFlow Autoinjector ("ReadyFlow Formulation"), a high-concentration formulation of furosemide that is delivered subcutaneously in under ten seconds. The sNDA has been assigned a PDUFA target action date of July 26, 2026.

In the United States, we are solely responsible for the commercialization of Afrezza, Furoscix and V-Go. Outside of the U.S., our strategy has been to establish regional partnerships in foreign jurisdictions where there are commercial opportunities, subject to the receipt of necessary foreign regulatory approvals. In December 2025, we supplied our partner in India, Cipla Ltd. ("Cipla"), with an initial shipment of Afrezza to support their launch of Afrezza in India.

The proprietary formulation and inhaler technologies used in Afrezza have also been deployed in our efforts to develop products to treat orphan lung diseases. Our first product to address an orphan lung disease, Tyvaso DPI (treprostinil) inhalation powder, received FDA approval in May 2022 for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension ("PAH") and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease ("PH-ILD"). Our development and marketing partner (sometimes referred to as our collaboration partner), United Therapeutics Corporation ("United Therapeutics" or "UT") began commercializing Tyvaso DPI in June 2022 and is obligated to pay us a royalty on net sales of the product. We also receive revenue for the supply of Tyvaso DPI that we manufacture for UT. In August 2025, we announced the expansion of our collaboration, pursuant to which we will formulate MNKD-1501, a second investigational molecule using our proprietary technologies, and United Therapeutics will conduct preclinical and clinical development activities. Per the agreement, we received an upfront payment and are eligible to receive milestone payments upon achievement of specified development milestones as well as royalties on net sales of MNKD-1501, if approved.

The other major program in our pipeline that will potentially address an orphan lung disease is MNKD-201, a dry-powder formulation of nintedanib for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis ("IPF"). An oral dosage form of nintedanib has been available for more than a decade. However, a fairly large oral dose is required in order to achieve sufficient drug levels in lung tissue. High systemic levels of nintedanib are often associated with undesirable side effects. Our goal with an inhaled formulation is to deliver a therapeutic amount of nintedanib to the lungs while avoiding high levels of the drug in other tissues. In 2024, we conducted a Phase 1 clinical study of MNKD-201, which met its primary objective of demonstrating positive safety results and good tolerability in healthy volunteers. We are currently conducting a Phase 1b

study of MNKD-201 in the United States, top line data expected in early 2H 2026, as well as a global Phase 2 study to assess the potential safety and efficacy of this investigational product in patients with IPF, in which we expect the first patient to be enrolled in in Q2 2026.

MNKD-701 is another pipeline opportunity that we are exploring. This program is focused on bumetanide, a more potent loop diuretic than furosemide. We are currently evaluating the feasibility of formulating bumetanide as a dry-powder that can be administered via oral inhalation.

Technosphere powders, such as Afrezza, Tyvaso DPI, MNKD-201 and MNKD-701, are based on our proprietary excipient, fumaryl diketopiperazine ("FDKP"), which is a pH-sensitive organic molecule that self-assembles into small particles under acidic conditions. Certain drugs can be loaded onto these particles by combining a solution of the drug with a solution or suspension of Technosphere material, which is then dried to powder form. The resulting powder has a consistent and narrow range of particle sizes with good aerodynamic properties that enable efficient delivery deep into the lungs. Technosphere powders dissolve quickly when the particles contact the moist lung surface with its neutral pH, releasing the drug molecules to diffuse across a thin layer of cells into the arterial circulation, bypassing the liver to provide excellent systemic exposure. In our Danbury, Connecticut facility, we can develop novel Technosphere formulations of different pharmaceutical ingredients and manufacture clinical and commercial supplies of these powders. In our manufacturing suites, we formulate commercial-scale quantities of both the Afrezza and Tyvaso DPI inhalation powders, fill plastic cartridges with the powders and package the cartridges into overwraps for Afrezza and blister packs for Tyvaso DPI. Afrezza and certain Tyvaso DPI final patient kits are assembled at our Connecticut facility, by combining overwraps or blister packs, inhalers, and the applicable package inserts. Final packaging of clinical supplies is performed by an external contract packager.

Our Technosphere powders are intended to be administered with our innovative, breath-powered, dry powder inhalers. Our inhalers are easy to use, cost-effective and can be produced in both a reusable (chronic treatment) and a single-use (acute treatment) format. Both the reusable and single-use inhaler formats use the same internal air-flow design. Both Afrezza and Tyvaso DPI use the reusable format (also known as Dreamboat). Being breath-powered, our inhaler requires only the patient's inhalation effort to deliver the powder. To administer a dose of the inhalation powder, a patient loads a cartridge into our inhaler and inhales through the mouthpiece. Upon inhalation, the dry powder is lifted out of the cartridge and broken up (or de-agglomerated) into small particles. The inhalers are engineered to produce an aggressive airstream that de-agglomerates the powder while keeping the powder moving relatively slowly. This slow-moving powder effectively navigates the patient's airways to reach the deep lung with minimal deposition at the back of the throat. Our inhalers show very little change in performance (i.e., efficient cartridge emptying) over a wide range of inhalation efforts. We have a supply agreement with the contract manufacturer that produces the plastic-molded parts for our inhaler and the corresponding cartridges. We expect to be able to qualify an additional vendor of plastic-molding contract manufacturing services, if warranted by demand. We assemble the inhalers from the individual components at our Connecticut facility.

headings: The products that we or our collaboration partner are commercializing may only achieve a limited degree of commercial success.
If United Therapeutics reduces its commercial emphasis on Tyvaso DPI, our revenues could decline materially.
Manufacturing risks may adversely affect our ability to manufacture our products and Tyvaso DPI, which could reduce our gross margin and profitability.
International trade policies, including tariffs, sanctions and trade barriers may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.
If third-party payers do not cover our approved products, such products might not be prescribed, used or purchased, which would adversely affect our revenues.

We may not realize the anticipated benefits of the scPharma acquisition or any future acquisition or strategic transaction; we may be unable to successfully integrate new products, technologies or businesses we acquire.
We may need to raise additional capital to fund our operations.
We expect that our results of operations will fluctuate for the foreseeable future, which may make it difficult to predict our future performance from period to period.
paragraphs: You should consider carefully the following information about the risks described below, together with the other information contained in this Annual Report before you decide to buy or maintain an investment in our common stock. We believe the risks described below are the risks that are material to us as of the date of this Annual Report. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of may also become important factors that affect us. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and future growth prospects would likely be materially and adversely affected. In these circumstances, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of the money you paid to buy our common stock.

Successful commercialization of therapeutic products is subject to many risks, including some that are outside our control. There are numerous examples of failures to fully exploit the market potential of therapeutic products, including by biopharmaceutical and device companies with more experience and resources than us. Products that we commercialize ourselves (including Afrezza, Furoscix and any products that we may develop or acquire in the future) and the product that is commercialized by our current collaboration partner (including future products that may be commercialized by a collaboration partner) may not gain market acceptance among physicians, patients, third-party payers and the healthcare community. The degree of market acceptance of our or a collaboration partner's products depends on many factors, including the following:

• effectiveness of efforts by us and/or any current or future collaboration or marketing partner to support and educate patients and physicians about the benefits and proper administration of our products, and the perceived advantages of our products and the disadvantages of competitive products;
• willingness of the healthcare community and patients to adopt new technologies or therapies;
• ability to manufacture the product in sufficient quantities with acceptable quality and cost;
• perception of patients and the healthcare community, including third-party payers, regarding the safety, efficacy and benefits compared to competing products or therapies;

Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 26, 2025, which discussion is incorporated herein by reference and which is available free of charge on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

paragraphs: 除非上下文另有要求，否則 "MannKind"、"we"、"Company"、"us" 及 "our" 皆指 MannKind Corporation 及其子公司。
我們是一家生物製藥公司，致力於透過創新、以患者為中心的解決方案，轉變慢性疾病的照護方式。我們專注於心臟代謝及罕見肺部疾病，開發並商業化治療方案，以解決嚴重未被滿足的醫療需求，包括糖尿病、肺動脈高血壓，以及心力衰竭與慢性腎臟病中的體液過多。我們在藥物與裝置組合方面擁有深厚的專業知識，目標是提供設計為能順利融入日常生活的療法。
我們的心臟代謝業務目前包含三種商業產品：Afrezza（人胰島素）吸入粉末；Furoscix（呋塞米注射液）；以及 V-Go 可穿戴式胰島素給藥裝置：
• Afrezza 是一種超快速作用的吸入式胰島素，用以改善糖尿病成人患者的血糖控制。Afrezza 是我們所開發的，由小型便攜式吸入器提供乾燥粉末形式的人胰島素。在用餐開始時給予，Afrezza 在吸入後會迅速溶解至肺部，並快速將胰島素送入血液循環。

• Furoscix 是一種新型呋塞米配方，可在五小時內透過體表輸注器提供 80 毫克劑量。Furoscix 用於治療體重至少為 43 公斤的兒童患者及患有慢性心力衰竭或慢性腎臟病的成人患者的水腫。Furoscix 是美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准的首個皮下循環利尿劑，可在家中提供與靜脈注射等效的利尿效果，而非醫院環境。Furoscix 是由 scPharmaceuticals Inc.（"scPharma"）所開發，我們於 2025 年 10 月取得其公司。請參閱財務報表附註 3 - 企業合併，包含於第二部分，項目 8 – 財務報表及補充資料。

• V-Go 是一種機械式基礎-追加胰島素給藥系統，可貼身穿戴，並可消除每日多次注射的需要。V-Go 會在 24 小時內持續提供預設的基礎速率胰島素，並在用餐時提供隱蔽的追加劑量。V-Go 於 2010 年獲得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）的 510(k) 清單核准，並自 2012 年起開始商業銷售。於 2022 年 5 月，我們從 Zealand Pharma A/S 及 Zealand Pharma US, Inc.（合稱 "Zealand"）取得 V-Go。

我們預期在 2026 年，我們的心臟代謝業務將有兩個潛在里程碑，基於我們在 2025 年提交的監管申請。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）目前正在審查一項補充生物製品許可申請（"sBLA"），我們正尋求批准 Afrezza 用於患有第一型或第二型糖尿病的兒童及青少年。此 sBLA 已被指定為美國藥物使用者費用法案（"PDUFA"）的目標行動日期為 2026 年 5 月 29 日。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）同時也在審查一項補充新藥申請（"sNDA"），我們正尋求批准 Furoscix ReadyFlow Autoinjector（"ReadyFlow Formulation"），一種高濃度呋塞米配方，可在十秒內透過皮下注射給藥。此 sNDA 已被指定為美國藥物使用者費用法案（"PDUFA"）的目標行動日期為 2026 年 7 月 26 日。
在美國，我們獨自負責 Afrezza、Furoscix 及 V-Go 的商業化。在美國以外的地區，我們的策略是於有商業機會的國家或地區建立區域性合作夥伴關係，但須取得必要的外國監管核准。於 2025 年 12 月，我們向印度的合作夥伴 Cipla Ltd.（"Cipla"）發送了 Afrezza 的初始貨運，以支持其在印度推出 Afrezza。

本公司所使用的 Afrezza 零組件及吸入器技術，亦已應用於我們開發用以治療罕見肺部疾病的產品。我們首個用以治療罕見肺部疾病的產品 Tyvaso DPI (treprostinil) 吸入粉末，於 2022 年 5 月獲得美國食品藥物管理局 (FDA) 批准，用以治療肺動脈高血壓 ("PAH") 及與間質性肺病 ("PH-ILD") 相關的肺動脈高血壓。我們的開發與行銷夥伴 (有時稱為合作夥伴) United Therapeutics Corporation ("United Therapeutics" 或 "UT") 於 2022 年 6 月開始商業化 Tyvaso DPI，並有義務就該產品的淨銷售額支付我們版稅。我們亦因供應 Tyvaso DPI 而獲得收入，該產品為我們為 UT 所製造。於 2025 年 8 月，我們宣佈擴展合作關係，根據協議，我們將使用本公司專有技術製造 MNKD-1501，為第二個正在研究中的分子，而 United Therapeutics 將進行預臨牀及臨牀開發活動。根據協議，我們已收到一筆預付費用，並有資格在達成特定開發里程碑時獲得里程碑付款，以及在 MNKD-1501 被批准後，就其淨銷售額收取版稅。

我們管線中另一個主要項目，潛在可解決罕見肺部疾病的是 MNKD-201，為 nintedanib 的乾粉配方，用以治療特發性肺纖維化 ("IPF")。nintedanib 的口服劑型已可用超過十年。然而，為了在肺部組織中達到足夠的藥物濃度，需要較大的口服劑量。高系統性 nintedanib 濃度通常與不希望的副作用相關。我們的目標是透過吸入配方，將足夠的 nintedanib 送達肺部，同時避免在其他組織中產生高濃度的藥物。於 2024 年，我們進行了 MNKD-201 的第一期臨牀研究，該研究達成其主要目標，即顯示在健康志願者中安全性良好且耐受性佳。目前，我們正在美國進行 MNKD-201 的第一期b
研究，預計於 2026 年上半年公佈初步數據，同時也在進行全球第二期研究，評估此正在研究中的產品在 IPF 患者中的潛在安全性與有效性，預計於 2026 年第二季開始納入第一個患者。
MNKD-701 是我們正在探索的另一個管線機會。此項目聚焦於 bumetanide，一種比 furosemide 更強效的環狀利尿劑。目前，我們正在評估將 bumetanide 製成乾粉，並透過口服吸入方式給藥的可行性。

Technosphere 乾粉，如 Afrezza、Tyvaso DPI、MNKD-201 和 MNKD-701，均基於我們專有的賦形劑 fumaryl diketopiperazine ("FDKP")，這是一種 pH 敏感的有機分子，在酸性條件下會自組成小顆粒。某些藥物可以透過將藥物溶液與 Technosphere 材料的溶液或懸浮液結合，再將其乾燥成粉末形式，載入這些顆粒上。所得到的粉末具有一致且範圍窄的顆粒大小，具有良好的空氣動力學特性，可有效將藥物送達肺深部。Technosphere 乾粉在顆粒接觸具有中性 pH 的濕潤肺表面時會迅速溶解，釋放藥物分子穿越一層細胞進入動脈循環，繞過肝臟，提供優良的全身暴露。在 Connecticut 的 Danbury 工廠，我們可以開發不同藥物成分的新型 Technosphere 乾粉配方，並製造臨牀及商業用途的這些粉末。在製造區域，我們製造 Afrezza 和 Tyvaso DPI 吸入粉末的商業規模數量，將粉末裝入塑膠 cartridges，並包裝成 Afrezza 的 overwraps 和 Tyvaso DPI 的 blister packs。Afrezza 和某些 Tyvaso DPI 的最終患者套件在 Connecticut 工廠組裝，透過組合 overwraps 或 blister packs、吸入器及適用的說明書。臨牀用量的最終包裝由外部合同包裝商執行。

我們的 Technosphere 乾粉旨在與我們創新、以呼吸為動力的乾粉吸入器一起使用。我們的吸入器易於使用、成本效益佳，並可製造為可重複使用 (慢性治療) 和一次性使用 (急性治療) 兩種格式。可重複使用與一次性使用吸入器均使用相同的內部氣流設計。Afrezza 和 Tyvaso DPI 均使用可重複使用格式 (亦稱為 Dreamboat)。由於以呼吸為動力，我們的吸入器僅需患者吸入的力氣即可將粉末送達。要給藥，患者將 cartridges 裝入吸入器，並透過嘴部吸入。吸入時，乾粉會從 cartridges 中被提起並分解 (或解聚) 成小顆粒。吸入器設計為產生強烈的氣流，使粉末解聚，同時保持粉末移動較慢。這種移動較慢的粉末能有效導航患者的呼吸道，到達肺深部，並在喉部後方有極少沉積。我們的吸入器在廣泛的吸入努力範圍內表現變化極小 (即高效的 cartridges 空出)。我們與製造吸入器塑膠模具零件及對應 cartridges 的合同製造商有供應協議。若需求所必需，我們預期能資格額外的塑膠模具合同製造服務供應商。我們在 Connecticut 工廠從個別零組件組裝吸入器。

paragraphs: 以下有關本公司財務狀況及營運成果之討論，應與本年度10-K表報表所附之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。

有關本會計年度終了日為2024年12月31日之營運成果與前會計年度終了日為2023年12月31日之營運成果變動之討論，已從本年度10-K表報表中省略，但可於本公司2024年12月31日會計年度之10-K表報表中「項目7. 管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之分析」部分找到，該年度10-K表報表已於2025年2月26日向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交，此討論已 herein by reference 納入參考，且可免費於SEC網站 www.sec.gov 網站取得。
本公司為一家生物製藥公司，致力於透過創新、以患者為中心的解決方案，轉變慢性疾病照護。我們專注於心血管代謝及罕見肺部疾病，開發並推廣治療方案，以解決嚴重未被滿足的醫療需求，包括糖尿病、肺動脈高壓、以及心衰竭及慢性腎臟病中的體液過多問題。我們在藥物與裝置組合領域擁有深厚的專業知識，旨在提供設計為能順利融入日常生活的療法。
本公司心血管代謝業務目前包含三項商業產品：Afrezza（人胰島素）吸入粉末；Furoscix（呋塞米注射液）；以及V-Go可穿戴式胰島素給藥裝置：
• Afrezza為一種超快速作用的吸入式胰島素，用以改善糖尿病成人之血糖控制。Afrezza由本公司開發，為一種人胰島素乾粉配方，透過小型便攜式吸入器給藥。於餐前使用，Afrezza經吸入後迅速溶解至肺部，並快速將胰島素送入血液循環。

• Furoscix為一種新型呋塞米配方，透過體表輸液器在五小時內給予80毫克劑量。Furoscix用於治療體重至少為43公斤之兒童患者及患有慢性心衰竭或慢性腎臟病之成人患者的水腫。Furoscix為美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准的首個皮下循環利尿劑，可在家中提供與靜脈注射等效的利尿效果，而非醫院環境。Furoscix由scPharma開發，本公司於2025年10月取得。詳見合併財務報表附註3 - 企業合併。
• V-Go為一種機械式基礎-追加胰島素給藥系統，可貼身佩戴，並可消除每日多次注射之需求。V-Go在24小時內持續以預設基礎速率給藥胰島素，並在用餐時提供隱蔽的追加劑量。V-Go於2010年獲得FDA 510(k) clearance，自2012年起已商業化。於2022年5月，本公司自Zealand取得V-Go。

本公司預期在2026年有兩個潛在里程碑，基於2025年提交的監管資料。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）目前正在審查一份sBLA，以尋求批准Afrezza用於患有第一型或第二型糖尿病的兒童及青少年。此sBLA已指定2026年5月29日為PDUFA目標行動日期。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）同時也在審查一份sNDA，以尋求批准Furoscix ReadyFlow Autoinjector，一種高濃度呋塞米配方，可在十秒內皮下給藥。此sNDA已指定2026年7月26日為PDUFA目標行動日期。
在美國，本公司獨自負責Afrezza、Furoscix及V-Go的商業化。在美國以外的地區，本公司策略為在有商業機會的外國司法管轄區建立區域性合作夥伴關係，但需取得必要的外國監管機構核准。2025年12月，本公司向印度的合作夥伴Cipla發送了Afrezza的初始貨運，以支持其在印度推出Afrezza。

用於Afrezza的專利配方及吸入器技術，也已應用於本公司開發治療罕見肺部疾病的產品。我們第一個針對罕見肺部疾病的產品Tyvaso DPI（treprostinil）吸入粉末，於2022年5月獲得FDA核准，用於治療PAH及PH-ILD。我們的開發與行銷夥伴United Therapeutics於2022年6月開始商業化Tyvaso DPI，並有義務就該產品的淨銷售額支付我們 royalty。我們也因供應由UT製造的Tyvaso DPI而獲得收入。2025年8月，我們宣佈擴大合作關係，根據協議，我們將使用專利技術製備MNKD-1501，一種第二種研究中的分子，而United Therapeutics將進行預臨牀及臨牀開發活動。根據協議，我們已收到一筆預付金，並有資格在達成特定開發里程碑時獲得里程碑付款，以及在MNKD-1501獲得核准後，就其淨銷售額收取 royalty。
我們管線中另一個主要計畫，可能針對罕見肺部疾病的是MNKD-201，一種用於治療IPF的nintedanib乾粉製劑。nintedanib的口服劑型已可用超過十年。然而，為了達到肺部組織足夠的藥物濃度，需要較大的口服劑量。高系統性nintedanib濃度常與

不希望的副作用有關。我們的目標是透過吸入製劑將足夠劑量的nintedanib送達肺部，同時避免在其他組織中出現高濃度的藥物。2024年，我們進行了MNKD-201的第1期臨牀研究，達成其主要目標，即顯示在健康志願者中安全性良好且耐受性佳。目前，我們正在美國進行MNKD-201的第1期b臨牀研究，預計2026年上半期公佈初步數據，同時也在進行全球第2期臨牀研究，評估此研究中產品在IPF患者的潛在安全性與有效性，預計2026年第二季開始納入第一位患者。
MNKD-701是我們正在探索的另一個管線機會。此計畫聚焦於bumetanide，一種比furosemide更強效的loop利尿劑。目前，我們正在評估將bumetanide製備為乾粉製劑，透過口服吸入方式給藥的可行性。
本公司業務面臨重大風險，包括但不限於本公司能否製造足夠數量的產品及Tyvaso DPI。其他重大風險也包括產品可能僅達到有限的商業成功程度，以及藥物開發、臨牀試驗及產品候選藥物的監管核准程序中固有的風險，某些情況下依賴合作夥伴的努力。美國政府持續變動的關稅政策可能提高未來取得製造產品所需原料及零組件的採購成本。我們正在積極監測此情況，並探討策略以降低風險。

headings: 本公司或合作夥伴商業化的產品可能只能達到有限的商業成功程度。
若 United Therapeutics 減少對 Tyvaso DPI 的商業重視，本公司營業收入可能大幅下降。
製造風險可能不利於本公司製造產品及 Tyvaso DPI 的能力，這可能會降低本公司毛利率及獲利能力。
國際貿易政策，包括關稅、制裁及貿易壁壘，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果及前景產生不利影響。
若第三方支付者未覆蓋本公司核准的產品，這些產品可能不會被開處、使用或購買，這將對本公司營業收入產生不利影響。
本公司可能無法實現 scPharma 收購或任何未來收購或戰略交易預期的效益；本公司可能無法成功整合所收購的新產品、技術或業務。
本公司可能需要籌措額外資金以支應營運需求。
本公司預期營運成果在可預見的未來將出現波動，這可能使預測未來營運表現變得困難。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮下列關於風險的說明資訊，並與本年度年報中其他資訊一併審閱，以作為決定是否買進或持有本公司普通股投資的參考。我們認為下列所列風險為本公司截至本年度年報日為止，對本公司而言具有重大影響的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，我們可能尚未知悉，這些因素也可能成為影響本公司的重要因素。若任何上述風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與未來成長前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分購入本公司普通股所支付的金額。

治療性產品的成功商業化面臨許多風險，包括一些超出本公司控制範圍的風險。許多案例顯示，治療性產品未能充分發揮其市場潛力，包括一些擁有更多經驗與資源的生物製藥與醫療器材公司。本公司自行商業化之產品（包括Afrezza、Furoscix以及本公司未來可能開發或取得的任何產品）與目前合作夥伴商業化之產品（包括未來合作夥伴可能商業化之產品），可能無法獲得醫師、患者、第三方付款者與醫療界之市場接受度。本公司或合作夥伴產品之市場接受度程度，取決於許多因素，包括以下各項：
• 本公司與/或任何現有或未來合作或行銷夥伴，努力支持與教育患者與醫師關於本公司產品之效益與正確使用方式，以及本公司產品之 perceived 優勢與競爭產品之缺點之成效；
• 醫療界與患者採用新技術或療法之意願；
• 有能力以足夠數量、可接受的品質與成本製造產品；
• 患者與醫療界（包括第三方付款者）對產品之安全性、有效性與效益，相較於競爭產品或療法之看法；
